sections.heading: Give specific, supportive feedback
sections.content: Make feedback specific, and communicate that you care about the person and want them to achieve their goals. Maya says this can help the person improve and strengthen your relationship.

sections.heading: Address underperformance as a possible role-fit problem
sections.content: Rather than assuming someone is inherently bad, lazy, or ineffective, consider whether the role is the wrong fit. Approach the conversation with care and a commitment to the person's success. Then work together either to resolve the issues or identify a better fit—including a next step outside your team or company. Maya frames this as continuing to mentor the person, not giving up on them.
